Title: Azure Monitor for containers - updates to live data settings

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for containers Live Data setting has changed for those who are using AAD with AKS. The redirect URI has changed.

  • If you have already set up with the previous URI, you will need to add the new URL which is presented in the documentation.
  • The old URI will be decommissioned soon and will provide error. Please follow the AAD configuration steps in the documentation.
